links.outcome: Model performance on prospective external multicenter validation cohorts
links.effect: AI2CCA achieved AUROCs of 1.00 and 0.965 in the French and Asian cohorts, respectively (with only one misclassified case in the Asian series).

links.outcome: Whether predictive entropy confidence estimates identify misclassified cases and improve performance when thresholded
